Chapter B2: Restrictions on payment of benefit – benefit offences
Scope and layout of Chapter

B2001 	The guidance in this Chapter deals with the restrictions on the payment of benefit in benefit offence cases. The guidance is split into two parts according to when the benefit offence was committed.
Introduction to Part 1
B2002 	The guidance in B2003 to B2106 deals with the restrictions on the payment of benefit following

1.	 
conviction for a first benefit offence 
2.	 
conviction for a second or subsequent benefit offence 
3.	 
acceptance of a penalty as an alternative to prosecution (administrative penalty or caution)

and relates to benefit offences committed up to and including 31.3.13. This guidance has been moved from DMG Chapter 08.
Note: For benefit offences committed on or wholly after 1.4.13, the guidance in (Part 2) B2201 et seq should be followed.
